result.summary: Reionization ionizing-photon-budget reconciliation at z~7: star-forming galaxies require f_esc=0.019 (+0.016/-0.009) to close the budget (Madau-Dickinson SFRD, log xi_ion=25.5+/-0.15, clumping C=2-5, JWST-SFRD tail), versus indirect-proxy-inferred f_esc=0.080 (+0.147/-0.051) from LzLCS O32/beta calibrations. Median delta(required-inferred)=-0.059 dex-frac (16-84%: -0.205 to -0.007); 11% of the systematic MC shows a shortfall. Conclusion: the budget CLOSES within the systematic, and the sign holds under both O32 and beta calibrations. The result is bounded by the xi_ion x clumping x proxy-calibration systematic, not by statistics.
result.title: The reionization ionizing-photon-budget shortfall for star-forming galaxies is not robust to systematics at z~7 (optimistic systematic corner)
result.provenance: Literature-anchored budget calculation — NO survey catalog data is used. The cosmic SFRD is the Madau & Dickinson (2014) analytic fitting function; xi_ion and the O32/beta f_esc proxy calibrations are adopted published values (LzLCS: Chisholm+22, Flury+22; Simmonds+24). Do NOT state or imply that this study uses JWST, SDSS, or TNG observational/catalog data — it is a systematics reconciliation over published literature values.

expected_value.reason:
sc = 0.019 (+0.016/-0.009) at z~7 can be compared to the expected value ranges for z=7, which are 0.1607-0.4451 (Mitra2013). However, there is also an indirect-proxy-inferred f_esc = 0.080 (+0.147/-0.051) from LzLCS O32/beta calibrations in the result. The directly measured value of 0.019 is significantly lower than both the literature range for z=7 and the indirectly inferred value.

Given that different metallicity scales can introduce legitimate differences due to calibration offsets, we must consider whether the discrepancy falls within a plausible range for such variations. However, the difference between the measured f_esc (0.019) and the expected ranges (starting from 0.1607 for z=7) is substantial, suggesting it goes beyond typical calibration offset tensions.

VERDICT: CONTRADICTS
